scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), zlib = require('zlib'), path = require('path'); const gz = path.resolve('data/subjectwise_fresh.sqlite.gz'), out = path.resolve('data/subjectwise_fresh.sqlite'); if (!fs.existsSync(out) && fs.existsSync(gz)) { console.log('[postinstall] Unpacking subjectwise database...'); fs.writeFileSync(out, zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync(gz))); console.log('[postinstall] Ready!'); }"
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('node', ['server/api_server.cjs'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npx', ['vite', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '5167', '--strictPort'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
